title: MONSTER CFB Game Total Page 1 Daily Slate V1

scope_lease.note: The authoritative same-workstream lease was atomically forward-ported before final proof to include the activation regression added during anti-loop recovery. The replacement preserved the same owner and approved Page-1 scope, added no parallel holder, and explicitly covers the selected-runtime protection declaration plus activation test artifact.

problem: CFB Game Total needs a true Page 1 that shows every FBS and FCS game for the selected Phoenix calendar day without mixing deep analysis into the slate.
root_cause: The prior active presentation was still a two-page reversal/cleanup layer over the historical Game Total chain. It did not provide a canonical all-games Phoenix-day Page 1, explicit compact/expand interactions, or auditable field-level multi-source route metadata for the slate.
patch: Add a read-only FBS+FCS Daily Slate API, deterministic observed-quote market consensus, mobile-first canonical Page-1 owner, and a CFB-only unselected-Page-1 routing context. Preserve selected-game runtime and frozen analysis artifacts, use Universal Sports field routing metadata, and activate the Daily Slate through the existing production outer router.
